## My Study Plan

I made a small example study plan for the first four courses in my MDS program.

```{python}
import pandas as pd

study = pd.DataFrame({
    "day": [
        "Mon", "Mon",
        "Tue", "Tue",
        "Wed", "Wed",
        "Thu", "Thu",
        "Fri", "Fri", "Fri", "Fri",
        "Sat", "Sat", "Sat", "Sat"],
    "course": [
        "DSCI 521", "DSCI 551",
        "DSCI 511", "DSCI 523",
        "DSCI 521", "DSCI 551",
        "DSCI 511", "DSCI 523",
        "DSCI 511", "DSCI 521", "DSCI 523", "DSCI 551",
        "DSCI 511", "DSCI 521", "DSCI 523", "DSCI 551"],
    "hours": [
        3.5, 4.5,
        3.5, 4.5,
        3.5, 4.5,
        3.5, 4.5,
        2, 2, 2, 2,
        2, 2, 2, 2]})
study
```

## Average Daily Study Time
```{python}
daily_hours = study.groupby("day")["hours"].sum().reindex(
    ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"])
daily_hours.mean()
```

## Daily Study Time

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.bar(daily_hours.index, daily_hours)
plt.ylabel("Hours per Day")
plt.show()
```
